info.name: Kiteworks API Documentation activities permissions API
Return the list of permissions available on a comment

params.name: comment_id
params.description: ID of the comment

params.name: id
params.description: Unique action identifier

params.name: id:in
params.description: Unique action identifier. Search for results that match any of the specified values for this parameter.

params.name: name
params.description: Action name

params.name: name:contains
params.description: Action name. Search for results that contain the specified characters in this parameter.

params.name: allowed
params.description: Determines if one has permissions to perform action

params.name: enabled
params.description: Determines if the given action is available considering the current object state (locked, deleted, etc.).

params.name: with
params.description: With parameters

params.name: mode
params.description: Determines the detail level of the response body.

items.docs: Returns the list of actions the current user is allowed to perform on the specified comment, such as editing or deleting it.
